name: jira-service-management
description: Jira Service Management (JSM) integration via the Atlassian Service Desk API — browse service desks and request types, list queues and their issues, read customer requests and SLAs, create requests, add comments, and answer approvals. Authenticates with Basic auth (Atlassian account email + API token) and stays strictly on /rest/servicedeskapi.
author: Buildersoft LLC

integration.description: Atlassian Jira Service Management customer requests, queues, SLAs, and approvals

fields.label: Atlassian URL
fields.patternMessage: Must be a valid Atlassian URL (e.g. https://yourorg.atlassian.net)
fields.helpText: Your Atlassian Cloud site URL (the same site that hosts your Jira Service Management projects).

fields.label: Email
fields.helpText: Email of the Atlassian account the API token belongs to.

fields.label: API Token
fields.helpText: Create at the Atlassian API tokens page. Tokens expire (max lifetime 1 year) — set a reminder to rotate the token and update this connection.

tools.name: jsm.list_service_desks
tools.description: List the service desks on the site (id, project key, project name). Pass serviceDeskId to instead list that desk's request types (id, name, description) — needed before creating a request.

serviceDeskId.description: When given, list the request types of this service desk instead of the service desks themselves

tools.name: jsm.list_queue_issues
tools.description: List the issues in a service desk queue (key, summary, status, requester, created). Omit queueId to list the desk's queues first. Requires the connection account to hold a licensed JSM agent seat on the project.

queueId.description: The queue id; omit to list the available queues instead

tools.name: jsm.get_request
tools.description: Get a customer request: current status, request type, reporter, participants, and created date.

issueIdOrKey.description: The request's issue id or key (e.g. ITS-42)

tools.name: jsm.get_request_slas
tools.description: Get the SLA cycles of a customer request: SLA name, breached flag, ongoing cycle with remaining time, and completed cycles.

issueIdOrKey.description: The request's issue id or key (e.g. ITS-42)

tools.name: jsm.create_request
tools.description: Create a customer request on a service desk, optionally raising it on behalf of a customer.

requestTypeId.description: The request type id (from jsm.list_service_desks with serviceDeskId)

raiseOnBehalfOf.description: Account id or email of the customer to raise the request for (requires agent permissions)

tools.name: jsm.add_request_comment
tools.description: Add a comment to a customer request. Comments are internal (agent-only) by default; set public to true to make them visible to the customer.

issueIdOrKey.description: The request's issue id or key (e.g. ITS-42)

public.description: true to make the comment visible to the customer (default false = internal)

tools.name: jsm.answer_approval
tools.description: Approve or decline a pending approval on a customer request. Only works when the connection account is the assigned approver for that approval.

issueIdOrKey.description: The request's issue id or key (e.g. ITS-42)

approvalId.description: The approval id on the request
